text:
𝗞𝗢𝗛𝗟𝗜 𝗦𝗛𝗜𝗡𝗘𝗦! 🇮🇳🔥

India beat NZ by 5 wkts (DLS) in the 1st ODI at Auckland.

Kohli 74 off 51 and a 113 stand with Gill 👏

#INDvNZ #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗞𝗢𝗛𝗟𝗜 𝗡𝗘 𝗝𝗘𝗘𝗧𝗔𝗬𝗔 𝗔𝗨𝗖𝗞𝗟𝗔𝗡𝗗! 🇮🇳🔥

👉 India ne NZ ko 5 wickets se haraya (DLS), 1st ODI, Eden Park
👉 NZ 185 all out, India ne 22.4 over mein 143/5 banaye
👉 Virat Kohli 74 off 51 balls (13 chauke + 1 chhakka)
👉 Kohli-Gill ki 113 run ki partnership
👉 Anshul Kamboj Player of the Match (2/22)

Kohli ki ye pari kaisi lagi? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #ViratKohli
